operators.name: mse_sum_forward
semantics: Computes mean squared error (MSE) between x and y: mean((x - y)^2) over all elements.
Equivalent to F.mse_loss(x, y) with default reduction='mean'.
Then torch.sum(loss) on the scalar returns the same scalar, so final result equals MSE.
Requires both tensors on CUDA and contiguous; output is 0-dim float32 tensor.
F.mse_loss with reduction='mean' computes elementwise squared difference and averages over all elements.
Output is a scalar tensor (0-dim) on CUDA, float32.
torch.sum of a 0-dim tensor returns the same scalar tensor.
Returns the scalar tensor computed in step_002.
